t: Milwaukee M18 BPDN-402C 18V combi drill designed for high-performance drilling, screwdriving, and hammer drilling in wood, metal, or masonry. The cordless tool is suitable for plumbers, electricians, and onsite building contractors, with the compact 198mm length permitting easy access into tight spaces. Features a high-performance 4-pole motor to deliver maximum power while maintaining a balanced power-to-weight ratio. RedLink overload protection electronics safeguards both tool and battery pack from damage during intense applications. Equipped with all-metal gearing to provide long-term durability, and a full-metal, 13mm keyless chuck for rapid bit changes. The fan-cooled motor prevents overheating to extend operational life. Also designed with comfortable rubber overmould grip to reduce operator fatigue during prolonged use. Supplied with 2 x 4.0Ah Li-ion batteries, multi-charger, and blow-moulded case. Batteries compatible with all M18 tools in the range.
